queries.prompt: Add `Builtin.Faithfulness` and a `@custom_code_based_evaluator` quality gate with 2% production `online-eval` sampling to our AgentCore project.

Run `agentcore run eval` against traces emitted from my local `agentcore dev` session without deploying to AWS.
